With synthetic data generation for data enrichment, can i use close source like OpenAI API or only use opensource model

[message_id=3429582 author=CPMP first=False]
You must comply with the license of the LLM you use. Some allow the use of output to train other models. Some don't allow this. It is your responsibility to comply with these licenses.

[message_id=3428971 author=Komil Parmar first=False]
Some companies were recently sued for doing what they call a 'Distillation Attack' (Knowledge Distillation) on OpenAI's ChatGPT and Anthropic Clade. So you decide.
